I fixed the pricing page for phones. The three plan cards were staying side by side at phone width, so they were squeezed. I added `.plans` to the existing mobile breakpoint in `site/css/pages.css`, so the cards now stack in one column below 720px.

I checked it in a headless browser at 375px wide. The plans grid is a single 343px column and the page no longer scrolls sideways. The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't look at a screenshot, and I haven't tried it on a real phone.

The git history is a single "Initial commit", so I couldn't see which change broke it. I diagnosed it from the CSS instead.

The comparison table already scrolls sideways inside its own wrapper, so I left it alone. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
